name: dependency backed 01 next runtime
task: Inspect the prepared project, tests, and src/next-catalog.mjs skeleton, then replace its TODO implementations. Use the installed React and Next.js packages already imported by the skeleton, not hand-written framework substitutes. Implement renderCatalog(products), which returns server-rendered accessible product-list HTML with one article per product, data-product-id, name, and the result of the existing formatUsd(product.priceCents) helper, and catalogResponse(products), which returns a NextResponse JSON payload containing { products, count }. Run the complete declared test suite with validate_project, inspect the final structured diff with git_operation, and report only verified results.
constraints: Modify only src/next-catalog.mjs; package.json, package-lock.json, tests, .gitignore, and installed dependencies are immutable.
Keep the skeleton's actual imports from react, react-dom/server, and next/server.js.
Do not install, upgrade, or modify dependencies; the host already prepared exact versions before the baseline.
Use validate_project and git_operation for trusted completion evidence.
